verdict.rationale: No first-party doc describes a GitHub integration. One community report (omnara-comm-19) shows a 'connect github' OAuth flow exists, but that user hit a redirect_uri error. Beyond that, only the generic ability to connect MCP servers or your own machine (omnara-docs-5, omnara-docs-17, omnara-docs-12) suggests an indirect route to repo access. missing for 10: documented GitHub repo connection, evidence that agents can read repo code via that connection, evidence of opening pull requests, a working hands-on report of the GitHub OAuth flow.
